build.buildCommand: npx prisma generate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && (npx tsx apps/api/prisma/seed.ts || echo seed-falhou-subindo-sem-ele) && node apps/api/dist/server.js
